mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% consistently signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE increases by >0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate collapsing consumer demand, triggering corporate earnings revisions that produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During post-pandemic recovery, industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 105.0 index points signals strengthening manufacturing output that supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during post-pandemic recovery when INDPRO exceeds 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly payroll growth exceeding 100,000 jobs (PAYEMS > 100,000) consistently indicates robust consumer spending momentum that elevates corporate earnings expectations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS exceeds 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% signals emergency monetary policy during severe economic stress, which precedes rapid equity market rebounds and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS falls below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate decline and CPIAUCSL exceeding 235.0 index points indicate central banks tolerating transitory inflation to support growth, which drives positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.0.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion, housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1,000,000 units signals accelerating consumer confidence that boosts retail spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during early-cycle expansion when HOUST exceeds 1000.
